name: zenmoney-receipts
description: Safely match, categorize, reconcile, split, or create ZenMoney receipt expenses and review spending groups.

interface.shortDescription: Categorize receipts and review spending safely.
interface.longDescription: Turns receipts into one verified expense per supported category, reconciles existing expenses, reviews category granularity, and finds evidence-based saving opportunities without persisting financial data.
defaultPrompt: Add this receipt to ZenMoney, one transaction per category.
Suggest more or less granular ZenMoney categories.
Review my history and suggest realistic savings.
